title: audit file:line citations in any artifact, and a read-only ask path that uses it
desc:
Only sdd.json is audited. review-diff findings, the trace-incident chain and address-review replies are told to quote file:line, but nothing checks it. There is also no entry point for the most common daily task: asking a question about the code and getting an answer whose citations are verified.

ACCEPTANCE:
- wb cite check <file.md> extracts `path:line` references with their quoted text and reuses audit._check; exit 7 on any unverified citation, output in the audit's format
- the same provenance rules as the audit apply (committed content, no .workflow, no ignored files)
- review-diff, trace-incident and address-review end with wb cite check on what they wrote
- an ask flow writes .workflow/ask-<slug>.md and must pass wb cite check before the answer is presented; the skill-description budget test still passes (fold into an existing skill or shared reference if a new skill breaks the ceiling)
- regression tests for the extractor and for each verdict
